description: This file defines the 'ADODB_pdo_mysql' class, which is a driver implementation for PDO MySQL in the ADODB database abstraction library. It includes methods to retrieve server info, meta data about tables and columns, and execute SQL queries with limit and transaction settings.

classes.name: ADODB_pdo_mysql
classes.description: A driver class extending ADODB_pdo for MySQL-specific implementations using PDO.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the driver with parent driver configurations, such as transaction capability and connection attributes.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves and returns information about the MySQL server version.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Fetches metadata about database tables, optionally filtered by schema and mask.

methods.name: SetTransactionMode
methods.description: Sets the transaction isolation level for the database session.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for columns of a specified table, including type, default value, nullability, and other attributes.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with LIMIT and OFFSET for pagination, optionally caching the results.
